module: GE extension `core_input_vibrationDebug`: "Vibration Debug" ImGui debug window to tune in real time the controller vibration (haptics) parameters of the player's vehicle. Each modified field sends a command to the haptics extension on the vehicle side. Useful to test force feedback, not a lasting API.
notes: The window is drawn on every onUpdate as long as the extension is loaded; the fields are only displayed if a player vehicle exists.
Commands sent to the vehicle: haptics.setWheelSlipForceMultiplier(x), haptics.setJerkForceMultiplier(x), haptics.setWheelSlipMin(x), haptics.setJerkMin(x).

Inconsistency: initial value of wheelSlipMin = 2.0, but onVehicleSwitched resets it to 4 (jerkMin 30 and multipliers 1 are identical); the displayed values are not sent back to the new vehicle, only the display is reset.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: draws the ImGui window and sends to player vehicle 0 the new force multiplier values (wheel slip, jerks) and minimum thresholds.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook on vehicle change: resets the window fields to their default values (multipliers 1, wheelSlipMin 4, jerkMin 30) without sending them back to the vehicle.
